item.title: From Cron Job to Self-Healing Pipeline, what I learnt in my first year building EO data pipelines
item.description: When I was working as a marine scientist I used to babysit my data pipelines, checking the outputs every morning and re-running things by hand. Here is what I learnt in my first year building reliable Earth observation pipelines.

item.title: My first FOSS4G: a conference full of people who love open source and sharing knowledge
item.description: What I got out of my first FOSS4G — giving a talk, helping run the eoAPI + STAC workshop, and the policy talks and hallway conversations that stuck with me.

item.title: When Zarr Stopped Being a File Format: Notes from my first weeks at Development Seed!
item.description: Why understanding Zarr as an API rather than a file format changed my way of thinking about cloud-native geospatial pipelines

item.title: Joining Development Seed to Build Earth Observation Infrastructure
item.description: Excited to announce I’m joining Development Seed as a Cloud Engineer to work on geospatial infrastructure for ESA and ECMWF. From oceanographic fieldwork to satellite data engineering, my journey with Earth observations continues!
